       MIN(t1.title) AS first_movie,
       MIN(t2.title) AS second_movie
FROM movie_link ml
JOIN title t1 ON t1.id = ml.movie_id
JOIN kind_type kt1 ON t1.kind_id = kt1.id AND kt1.kind IN ('tv series', 'episode')
JOIN title t2 ON t2.id = ml.linked_movie_id
JOIN kind_type kt2 ON t2.kind_id = kt2.id AND kt2.kind IN ('tv series', 'episode')
JOIN link_type lt ON ml.link_type_id = lt.id AND lt.link IN ('sequel', 'follows', 'followed by')
JOIN movie_info_idx mi_idx1 ON mi_idx1.movie_id = ml.movie_id
JOIN info_type it1 ON mi_idx1.info_type_id = it1.id AND it1.info = 'rating'
JOIN movie_info_idx mi_idx2 ON mi_idx2.movie_id = ml.linked_movie_id
JOIN info_type it2 ON mi_idx2.info_type_id = it2.id AND it2.info = 'rating'
JOIN movie_companies mc1 ON mc1.movie_id = ml.movie_id
JOIN company_name cn1 ON mc1.company_id = cn1.id AND cn1.country_code != '[us]'
JOIN movie_companies mc2 ON mc2.movie_id = ml.linked_movie_id
JOIN company_name cn2 ON mc2.company_id = cn2.id
WHERE t2.production_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
  AND mi_idx2.info < '3.5';
